description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it and Lonis trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
